task.title: P6-123: Enforce SELECTION_MOVE_MAX consistently across all four sites
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-123. Size: S. Specs: specs/collection-api.md, specs/app-ui.md.

**`SELECTION_MOVE_MAX` is enforced in exactly one of the four places it matters** (was `P6-061a` + `P6-061b` + `P6-061h`). `move_selection` caps at 100 (`lib.rs:1047-1049`); `undo_selection_move` has no length check at all (`:1182-1197`), `selection_destinations` silently `.take(SELECTION_MOVE_MAX)`s so a >100 selection gets a ranking computed from an arbitrary subset (`:1219`), and the constant is never referenced client-side, so selecting >100 rows produces a raw server-fn error string in the toast instead of being prevented in the tray.
